bime: “Yonder’s my ole mudder, Been waggin’ at de hill so long; ’Bout time she cross over, Git home bime-by.”
bim:
'At time an' labor ever stunt.
An' so I let my fist go "bim,"
I thought I 'd mos' nigh finished him.
bimbisar: Over the relic of Lord Buddha King Bimbisar built a shrine, a salutation in white marble.
